summary.bn: ব্যাটারির কারেন্ট দিয়ে দুটো মোটর চালায়; পিন শুধু দিক আর গতি বলে।
summary.en: Drives two motors from a battery; the pins only set direction and speed.

simplified: What its outputs lose is fitted to two typical figures in the chip's datasheet. A real chip loses more as it heats up, and chips differ.
It does not heat up or shut itself off. A real one gets hot at an ampere or more and stops when too hot.
A motor here is a plain resistance, so there is no spike when it is switched off; the module's protection diodes are left out.
The 5 V regulator is always connected (its jumper is taken to be in place) and needs the supply 2 V above its output. That figure, and what the module draws at rest, are estimates.
An unconnected input reads LOW. On a real module it can read either way.
It is drawn with screw terminals a wire end can be put into; the six control pins are a row of pins on the real module.
